input: 16 identifiers of the release 116 GRCh38 variation cache on chromosome 21, each as a VCF record at its site (variants.vcf) and, record for record in the same order, as one identifier per line (variants.id.txt): substitutions (rs781261918, rs2123538435, rs267606642), multi-allelic substitutions (rs779189159 C/A/G, rs2838519 G/A/C, rs142566111 T/A/G), the insertion rs797045539 (-/T), the deletions rs886039732 (TTTGT/-) and rs398123645 (A/-), three features the cache stores un-minimised, which Ensembl VEP minimises before annotation (rs1601245742 TTTTT/TTTTTT, rs2057997486 GGG/GG, rs759281545 TGTGTGTG/TGTGTG), the multi-allelic indel rs1160505542 it leaves un-minimised, rs2838519 written again in upper case (RS2838519), and two variants whose feature has no alternate allele (rs1979841086 and rs782416306, allele string dbSNP_novariation), for which Ensembl VEP writes no default or tab row, a JSON object whose most_severe_consequence is ? and a VCF line; their VCF twins are substitutions at the same sites. The VCF records carry the reference base before each indel from the GRCh38 primary assembly.

id.vep_command: vep -i variants.id.txt -o <out> --database --host ensembldb.ensembl.org --port 3306 --user anonymous --db_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --uploaded_allele --variant_class --mask_header_cache_path --format id [--tab|--vcf|--json]
id.input_notes: the identifiers of variants.vcf's ID column, one per line and in its order; Ensembl VEP resolves them through its variation database, which it reads for this format alone, and annotates each mapping against the database's transcripts; vep-rs resolves them from the corpus cache's variation slice (json_cache/variations/21/all_vars.gz)
id.warnings: none for the default-format run (every identifier resolves)

id-guess.vep_command: vep -i variants.id.txt -o <out> --database --host ensembldb.ensembl.org --port 3306 --user anonymous --db_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --uploaded_allele --variant_class --mask_header_cache_path [--tab|--vcf|--json]
id-guess.expected_outputs: the id set's files (expected_id): Ensembl VEP detects the format from the first data line, a single field that is neither a region, an SPDI, a CAid nor an HGVS notation, so its output for the list without --format is the output of the id set
id-guess.input_notes: the identifiers of variants.vcf's ID column, one per line and in its order; Ensembl VEP resolves them through its variation database, which it reads for this format alone, and annotates each mapping against the database's transcripts; vep-rs resolves them from the corpus cache's variation slice (json_cache/variations/21/all_vars.gz)
